changes.detail: Ballistic now respawns with his Sling weapon in all game modes.
changes.raw_text: Ballistic now respawns with his Sling weapon in all game modes.

changes.detail: Overheat no longer degrades when not firing or swapping to another weapon, and overheat does not increment when swapping to another weapon and shooting.
changes.raw_text:
- Overheat no longer degrades when not firing or swapping to another weapon.
- Overheat does not increment when swapping to another weapon and shooting.

changes.detail: Overheat now only applies to one weapon.
changes.raw_text:
- Overheat now only applies to one weapon.
    - If a player has a weapon out when hit by Whistler the overheat debuff applies only to that weapon.
    - If the player is unarmed when hit by Whistler it applies to the weapon in the first weapon slot.

changes.detail: Tactical charges increased from 1 to 2.
changes.raw_text: - Tactical charges increased from 1 to 2.

changes.detail: Ballistic and teammates within range get a sprint boost when his Ultimate is activated.
changes.raw_text: - Ballistic and teammates within range get a sprint boost when his Ultimate is activated.

changes.detail: Level 2 Upgrades: Extra Bullet - Gain an additional Tactical charge, Trap Mode - When placed in the world, Ballistic’s KTactical lasts 15 seconds and deals 35 damage if an enemy walks into it.
changes.raw_text:
- Level 2
    - **Extra Bullet:** Gain an additional Tactical charge.
    - **Trap Mode:** When placed in the world, Ballistic’s KTactical lasts 15 seconds and deals 35 damage if an enemy walks into it.

changes.detail: Level 3 Upgrades: Quiet Time - Ballistic’s Tactical no longer applies overheat, Killing Time - Now moved to level 3, still provides a 15 second extension to Ballistic’s Ultimate.
changes.raw_text:
- Level 3
    - **Quiet Time:** Ballistic’s Tactical no longer applies overheat. Instead it adds silence and slow on *hit*. It also has a longer cooldown.
    - **Killing Time:** Now moved to level 3, still provides a 15 second extension to Ballistic’s Ultimate.

changes.detail: Pathfinder now tucks in his legs while riding horizontal ziplines.
changes.raw_text: - Pathfinder now tucks in his legs while riding horizontal ziplines.

changes.detail: Tactical charges increased from 1 to 2.
changes.raw_text: - Tactical charges increased from 1 to 2.

changes.detail: Increased launch speed of the zipline projectile, reduced cooldown from 3 minutes to 2 minutes.
changes.raw_text:
- Increased launch speed of the zipline projectile.
- Reduced cooldown from 3 minutes to 2 minutes.

changes.detail: Level 2 Upgrades: Field Research - Now grants all Recon perks instead of just the survey beacon scan, Ringmaster - Now grants all Controller perks instead of just the ring console access.
changes.raw_text:
- Level 2
    - **Field Research:** Now grants all Recon perks instead of just the survey beacon scan.
    - **Ringmaster:** Now grants all Controller perks instead of just the ring console access.

changes.detail: Level 3 Upgrades: Landing Gear - Grants more air control and faster recovery from hard landings.
changes.raw_text:
- Level 3
    - **Landing Gear:** Grants more air control and faster recovery from hard landings.

changes.detail: Increased the activation speed of the heartbeat sensor, decreased the interval time between heartbeats, decreased activation time for unarmed ADSing.

- Decreased activation time for unarmed ADSing

changes.detail: Reduced the delay between the launch and hit, improved the slow on hit.

- Improved the slow on hit

changes.raw_text: - Upon deployment, there is now a quick 2 second scan of the area which will highlight any enemy in the area.

changes.raw_text: - Cloaked enemies will now show footsteps if they are within the Ultimate zone.

fr-fr.title: Apex Legends™: Overclocked Midseason Patch Notes

changes.detail: Ballistic now respawns with his Sling weapon in all game modes.
changes.raw_text: Ballistic now respawns with his Sling weapon in all game modes.

changes.detail: Overheat debuff duration increased, overheat damage increased, tactical charges increased and time between firing and homing activation decreased.
changes.raw_text: Overheat now only applies to one weapon. If a player has a weapon out when hit by Whistler the overheat debuff applies only to that weapon. If the player is unarmed when hit by Whistler it applies to the weapon in the first weapon slot. Overheat no longer degrades when not firing or swapping to another weapon. Overheat does not increment when swapping to another weapon and shooting. Overheat damage increased from 15 to 50. Overheat debuff duration increased from 12 to 15. Tactical charges increased from 1 to 2. Decreased time between firing and when homing activates.

changes.detail: Ballistic and teammates within range get a sprint boost when his Ultimate is activated.
changes.raw_text: Ballistic and teammates within range get a sprint boost when his Ultimate is activated. Sprint boost will only apply a speed boost while sprinting and will not speed up other types of movement.

changes.detail: Pathfinder now tucks in his legs while riding horizontal ziplines.
changes.raw_text: Pathfinder now tucks in his legs while riding horizontal ziplines.

changes.detail: Tactical charges increased and cooldown decreased.
changes.raw_text: Tactical charges increased from 1 to 2. Removed the progressive cooldown and it is now a flat 20 seconds.

changes.detail: Launch speed of the zipline projectile increased and cooldown decreased.
changes.raw_text: Increased launch speed of the zipline projectile. Reduced cooldown from 3 minutes to 2 minutes.

changes.detail: Activation speed of the heartbeat sensor increased, interval time between heartbeats decreased and activation time for unarmed ADSing decreased.
changes.raw_text: Increased the activation speed of the heartbeat sensor. Decreased the interval time between heartbeats. Decreased activation time for unarmed ADSing  The delay when aiming more consistent between weapon and unarmed.

changes.detail: Delay between launch and hit reduced and slow on hit improved.
changes.raw_text: Reduced the delay between the launch and hit. Improved the slow on hit, should now halt faster moving Legends more effectively.

changes.detail: Quick 2 second scan of the area upon deployment added and cloaked enemies show footsteps within Ultimate zone.
changes.raw_text: Upon deployment, there is now a quick 2 second scan of the area which will highlight any enemy in the area. Enemies that enter the area after it’s deployed will also be scanned for 2 seconds. Cloaked enemies will now show footsteps if they are within the Ultimate zone.

changes.detail: Max in-world count reduced and HP reduced.
changes.raw_text: Reduced max in-world count from 3 to 2. Reduced hp from 150 to 100.

changes.detail: Knocked players can no longer slide across zip codes as Axle or while under the effect of a Nitro Gate.
changes.raw_text: Knocked players can no longer slide across zip codes as Axle or while under the effect of a Nitro Gate. They can still boost through a Nitro Gate, but once the effect times out, they will slow down accordingly.

changes.detail: Kickstart now displaces victims on a parabolic arc based on their velocity at the moment of impact and enemy highlight duration reduced.
changes.raw_text: Kickstart now displaces victims on a parabolic arc based on their velocity at the moment of impact, instead of straight up. Reduced enemy highlight duration slightly to better match stun duration.

changes.detail: Cooldown increased.
changes.raw_text: Increased Cooldown from 22 seconds to 28 seconds.

changes.detail: Speed boost replaced by sprint boost.
changes.raw_text: The speed boost granted from running on the pucks dropped by the wrecking ball has been replaced by a sprint boost. Will no longer speed up all movement, just when sprinting.

changes.detail: Faster landing from skydiving removed.
changes.raw_text: Removed the recent improvement, which allowed her to land faster from skydiving.

changes.detail: Regen rate reduced, regen duration increased and ally/conduit total regen decreased.
changes.raw_text: Decreased Regen Rate from 15/s to 10/s. Increased Regen Duration from 6s to 8s. Decreased Ally Total Regen from 90 to 80. Decreased Conduit Total Regen from 60 to 56.

changes.detail: Cooldown increased.
changes.raw_text: Increased Cooldown from 27 seconds to 30 seconds.

changes.detail: Increased control while sliding.
changes.raw_text: DRIFT: Increased control while sliding. Axle accelerates and moves faster than others while sliding. She also has increased lateral control.

changes.detail: Deploy a speed gate that sends users into a boosted slide.
changes.raw_text: NITRO GATE: Deploy a speed gate that sends users into a boosted slide. Stepping into a Nitro Gate forces users into a speedy slide, where they have greatly increased velocity and lateral control.

changes.detail: Deploy an enemy-seeking drone that displaces targets on impact.
changes.raw_text: KICKSTART: Deploy an enemy-seeking drone that displaces targets on impact. Axle fires a drone straight out in front of her, where it traverses close to the ground in a straight line as it scans for enemies in a wide FoV.

changes.raw_text: Tracking a team with Spotters Lens will generate 70% of an ultimate bullet. 10 second cooldown per team

changes.raw_text: Vantage is immune to hard landings exiting the tac

changes.detail: The Legend Upgrade system allows players to tailor their Legend to their playstyle by unlocking unique ability upgrades at Levels 2 and 3.
